description: LV2-B1: the auto-selected shooter's deferred unit_selected_to_shoot window holds the player's first Quick-Assign (one ASSIGN_TARGET, or a burst of them); when the window closes the phase applies the held assignment(s), and the Shooting panel must show them. Before the fix the weapon rows kept '(Click to Select)', Confirm read 'Confirm (N weapons, N unassigned)', CURRENT TARGETS was empty and the stat line missed CLOSE-RANGE DAKKA's +1 RAPID FIRE. Part 1 (Decline, one weapon): phase entry auto-selects the Battlewagon (no window); a real click on Quick-Assign 'All -> Blade Champion Beta' opens the window first; a real Decline applies the held assignment and the panel shows '1->[A] Blade Champion Beta', 'Confirm (1 weapons)' and one CURRENT TARGETS row; Confirm / Fast / Done / Complete Shooting resolve the shot. Part 2 (Use, burst): the next auto-selected shooter (Dakkajet) is skipped with the real N key; the auto-selected Deff Dread's Quick-Assign 'All -> Prosecutors' sends two ASSIGN_TARGETs - the first opens the window, the second is held; a real click on 'Use on Deff Dread' (CLOSE-RANGE DAKKA, 1 CP) applies both and the panel shows both rows aimed at Prosecutors, 'Confirm (2 weapons)', two CURRENT TARGETS rows and the big shoota's [RF3] (RAPID FIRE 2 +1); the burst then resolves with rapid_fire_value 3.
